fact: The 2025 World Bank ID4D diagnostic states the national ID system covers about 63% of the population, the eCRVS holds births with NINs and was linked to the ID NIN by a March 2024 MOU, and Gambia's registers (voters, SIM, social security) are linked only through documents rather than data exchange.
title: Gambia Diagnostic: High-Level Assessment of Identity Management System
